notes.BTN_SOUTH: Wii A button toggles laptop/external active mode.
notes.BTN_EAST: Wii B trigger release selects the active GSV tile when external mode is active.
notes.KEY_LEFT_RIGHT: D-pad left/right scrolls the GSV carousel when external mode is active.
notes.BTN_MODE: Wii Home button is reserved for later.
notes.A_EXTERNAL_SHOWS_GSV: When A toggles into external mode, the wand asks the console to show the GSV carousel.
notes.A_REFRESH_EXTERNAL: If the wand is already in EXTERNAL mode but the viewer is not showing the GSV carousel, A asks the console to show the GSV instead of switching to LAPTOP.
notes.A_LAPTOP_NOTIFY: When A toggles to laptop mode, the wand notifies the console so STOP/idle returns can stay plain if the public GSV is no longer preferred.
notes.A_EXTERNAL_LOCAL_POKE: When A requests external mode, the wand also writes GSV_SHOW to the viewer-side command file for faster recovery from plain splash/image states.
notes.AUTO_CONNECT: At boot/login, start_wii_menu_wand.sh can run the Bluetooth auto-link helper. The Wii Remote still needs to be awake/blinking; press 1+2 or SYNC after reboot if it is asleep.
notes.BLUETOOTH_MAC: Set bluetooth_mac to the MAC address of the Wii Remote to auto-link. Current RVL-036 was previously seen as CC:9E:00:6C:0B:13.
notes.IR_MOUSE: In LAPTOP mode, the Nintendo Wii Remote IR event device moves a virtual mouse through /dev/uinput.
notes.IR_VALUES: hid-wiimote IR reports ABS_HAT0X/Y and ABS_HAT1X/Y. A value of 1023 normally means that IR point is not visible.
notes.LAPTOP_TRIGGER: In LAPTOP mode, the Wii B trigger is left mouse down/up, so holding B while aiming performs drag.
notes.LAPTOP_DPAD: In LAPTOP mode, D-pad provides small mouse nudges for fine positioning.
notes.IR_INVERT: If the mouse moves opposite the Wii Remote aim, flip ir_invert_x or ir_invert_y.
notes.IR_STABILIZED: v28.24.9 lowers sensitivity, requires two visible IR points by default, applies smoothing, rejects large jumps, and slows drag movement for precision.
notes.CONSOLE_MOUSE_BOUNDS: In laptop mode, the wand uses xdotool when available to clamp the pointer inside the laptop/console monitor bounds.
notes.XDOOTOOL_NOTE: If logs say xdotool is missing, install with: sudo apt install xdotool
notes.IR_TUNING: For more control, reduce ir_sensitivity or ir_max_step; for less stickiness, reduce ir_deadzone or increase ir_sensitivity slightly.
notes.LIVE_IR_TUNING: v28.25.0 adds Setup > Wii Remote IR Mouse with live tuning. The wand reloads wii_menu_wand_config.json while running; no restart needed after APPLY LIVE.
notes.IR_TUNING_BALANCED: Balanced default is sensitivity=1.15, deadzone=4, max_step=22, smoothing=0.50. Use Responsive if still lethargic; use Precision if too jumpy.
notes.IR_ABSOLUTE_MODE: v28.25.2 adds absolute IR mode: calibrated raw IR midpoint maps directly into console screen bounds.
notes.IR_CALIBRATION: In Setup > Wii Remote IR Mouse, use Reset Observed, move the remote through the usable aiming area, then Use Observed Range and Apply Live.
notes.IR_STATUS_FILE: wii_ir_status.json is written by the Wii Menu Wand with live raw midpoint, point count, dot distance, and observed min/max range.
